clue.text: Way to speed in the middle of the road

definitions.text: in the middle of the road

blocks.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing something
rate is speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: A motorist is told how fast to drive along the centre of a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the middle of the road' looks like a place to drive, but it is the idiom for unadventurous views.
explanation.definitionFit: Middle-of-the-road opinions avoid extremes, which is exactly what moderate opinions do.

clue.text: Call, say, for a holiday

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an emergency radio signal from ships or aircraft and the spring festival on the first of May.

clue.text: Ingredient needed, we hear, with crackers to make cakes

clue.text: Send back to post office or council
